_comment: ADR-0331. Agent scopes are operator configuration, not code: adding an agent or narrowing a remit must not require a rebuild. An agent with no `tools` array can call nothing -- a misconfigured agent does nothing rather than everything.

customer-agent._comment: Least privilege: its own subscriber's balance, charges and charge explanations. No catalog-wide enumeration, no NF inventory. `pinnedSubject` is set per session by the launcher; empty here means unpinned, which is why this agent must never be run unpinned in production.

revenue-agent._comment: Operator-domain only. Deliberately has NO subscriber-level tool: revenue questions are answered from aggregates, and giving it PII access would be scope it does not need.

ops-agent._comment: The half of a technical/ops agent that is not blocked on NWDAF: live NF inventory and catalog. It has no subscriber tools at all -- an ops agent has no business reading a customer's bill.
